skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic knowledge about network architecture, communication protocols, network classification criteria, layered architecture, OSI model, TCP/IP model.
Explain and apply principles of transmission techniques, calculate channel characteristics, understand and apply coding and modulation, error detection and correction, data transmission control.
Understand and explain basic elements of LAN: Ethernet standards, network devices, virtual LANs, wireless LANs.
Understand and explain WAN techniques: PSTN voice network, leased line connections, ISDN, DSL technologies.
Explain operation of TCP, UDP, IP protocols, routing protocols, common internet services. Apply subnetting techniques, configure IP addresses for computers and routers, use common internet services.
Apply learned knowledge to solve problems related to computer networks and data communication in real-world scenarios.
Present course content and solve related exercises.
Collaborate with team members to complete group assignments on time.
Have the ability to independently learn and understand relevant network system knowledge.
Develop awareness of social context, ethical responsibility, and social responsibility in the field of information technology.
